hero.titular: Advertising made from the side of the person who <key>searches</key>
hero.lede: Advia is an AdTech founded in Madrid in 2024. We use AI agents to identify the moments in which a consumer is researching before deciding, and position brands there as the answer.

porque.titular: For an ad to serve the advertiser, it first has to serve their <key>consumer</key>
porque.lede: It is the whole idea behind the company, and the reason it travels from channel to channel. Told in the order we lived it.

historia.desc: Like any consumer, the ads we saw while browsing didn't interest us. We had spent years inside the industry, and we could see why.
historia.eco: Almost every campaign is conceived and planned from the advertiser's side. It makes sense: they are the ones paying.

historia.desc: For an ad to serve the advertiser, it first has to serve their consumer. We founded Advia to plan from there.
historia.eco: You stop asking where your ad fits and start asking what your consumer is trying to find out.

historia.titulo: There are two ways to navigate
historia.desc: In the passive one, an algorithm or an editor chooses what we see. In the active one, we have a doubt or a decision to make, and we go out looking for information.
historia.eco: In those moments an ad doesn't have to interrupt: it can be the answer we were already looking for.

historia.desc: We built Vera to turn ads into answers wherever the question happens: the open web, YouTube and AI answers.
historia.eco: A concept, not a technology. The concept travels; the technology follows.

equipo.titular: A small team, all in Madrid, in three <key>areas</key>
equipo.lede: Each area is led by a founder. The three of us met at Seedtag and before that went through GroupM: the media side and the agency side, which is where you see what breaks between the plan and the result.
equipo.fotoAlt: The whole Advia team in the Madrid office, with the brand's neon sign

areas.desc: Sales to agencies, the strategy of each account and client service.
Vera, the product and the tools the rest of the team works with.
Campaign delivery, design and the processes that hold it together.

valores.titular: Five values that are <key>practised</key>, not hung on a wall
valores.lede: They came out of the exercise of writing down who we are, and the debate that forced us to have. They apply every day when we write, sell and deliver.
items: We work hard and enjoy doing it. We value agility, constant growth and each person contributing in their own way.
Technology doesn't replace people: it amplifies them. The person stays at the centre, and technology is an extension of what we know how to do.
Transparency, honesty and responsibility, even when they demand more of us. Effort is non-negotiable: we go one step further even if the client doesn't notice.
Constant curiosity about the future. The best ideas come from imagining what doesn't exist yet.
There are no individual wins. We grow together and win together: Advia's success belongs to the whole team.

cierre.titular: If the problem interests you, <key>write to us</key>
cierre.lede: Even if there is no open vacancy with your name on it. And if what you want is to see Vera on your category, that too.
